description: PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for turning an address or place name into precise coordinates — "geocode 350 5th Ave New York", "coordinates of the Eiffel Tower", "where is Invalidenstr 117 Berlin". High-accuracy geocoding from HERE. Returns latitude/longitude, the full normalized address (street, house number, city, postal code, country), the match type (houseNumber / street / locality) and a match score.

country.description: Optional ISO-3 country code to bias/limit, e.g. "USA", "DEU", "FRA".

q.description: Free-form address or place, e.g. "350 5th Ave, New York" or "Eiffel Tower, Paris".

name: here_geocode
